up: Retrieve the list of distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1136837. For each compound, provide the following: the ChEMBL compound identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), the maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), the molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and the canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). To obtain this data, start with the docs table filtered on docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1136837', join to compound_records on docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id, join to molecule_dictionary on compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, and join to compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Ensure each compound is listed only once by using DISTINCT on the output columns. No other filters should be applied.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1136837';
